Title: Azure Front Door Standard and Premium now in public preview

Body.Content: Azure Front Door is a secure cloud CDN service that cyber security teams can use to accelerate content delivery while protecting apps, APIs, and websites from cyberthreats. It combines intelligent threat protection and modern CDN technology in a tightly integrated service that’s easy to setup, deploy and manage.
